race.title: BAR 1 Betting Troytown Handicap Chase (Grade 3)
race.verdict: Gordon Elliott is responsible for half the field so holds every chance of winning this for a record eighth time, with THE ENABLER looking the pick dropped to a more suitable trip. His stablemate Better Days Ahead has a good record here so is another to consider, while Uhavemeinstitches is lurking on a dangerous mark if it all comes together. THE ENABLER (IRE) BETTER DAYS AHEAD (IRE) UHAVEMEINSTITCHES (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: The Enabler (9/2), Win Some Lose Some (5/1), The Wallpark (6/1), He's Gorgeous (8/1), Firefox (9/1), Better Days Ahead (11/1), Kinturk Kalanisi (12/1), Sportinthepark (12/1), Kish Bank (14/1), Uhavemeinstitches (16/1), Search For Glory (18/1), Patter Merchant (20/1), Will Do (22/1), Croke Park (25/1), Da Capo Glory (28/1), Intense Raffles (28/1), Vaureal (33/1), Perceval Legallois (40/1)
